d: The Arizona Drag Boat Association will sponsor the ADBA Finals from November 13 through November 15, 2026, from 0800 to 1730 daily. The event will consist of approximately 100 vessels racing on a 1,000-foot drag course directly in front of the BlueWater Resort and Casino in Parker, Arizona, on the Lower Colorado River. Latitude and longitude coordinates and VHF-FM channels monitored were not provided. For further information or comments, contact Jeremy Denny at 602-614-0560. All mariners are advised to transit the area with caution.
